note: Decorative full-screen backgrounds for the Daily Fitness TV Roku channel. Loaded at runtime so they are not bundled in the <=4MB Roku package. Dailymotion video/playlist assets are NOT hosted here. To refresh art without a Roku rebuild: overwrite the files in v1/images/ (same names) and push; or add v2/ and bump the app's REMOTE_ASSET_VERSION constant.
